svg.title: Biceps force as a book slides along the forearm
svg.desc: A book moves from 10 to 38 centimeters from the elbow. Because the biceps attaches only 4.00 centimeters from the pivot, its force grows from 196 to 470 newtons, more than seven times the supported weight. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A short lever arm makes the biceps work hard
Biceps 4.00 cm from the elbow; forearm 2.50 kg at 16.0 cm. Torques about the elbow balance: FB =
(r₂wa + r₃wb)/r₁, 470 N with the book at 38.0 cm.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
